_comment: Walls that already have somebody else's tag on them.
EVERY COORDINATE IN HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER. They are picked off the middle of the blocks
the mod already knows about, which puts them roughly in the right neighbourhood and
almost certainly not in front of an actual wall. This is the one thing in the mod that
cannot be got right from a desk: a tag has to be somewhere you can stand facing a flat
surface, on a block that belongs to somebody.
TO FIX ONE: stand where Franklin should stand to paint, facing the wall, and read the X,
Y, Z and heading straight off the HUD into the entry below. The heading is what turns him
to face the wall, so it matters as much as the position.
KEEP THEM CLOSE. The run is done on a push bike, so everything here is within a few
streets of Chamberlain and Davis. A wall out in El Burro or La Mesa is a ten minute ride
each way and turns a short job into a commute -- those were tried and taken back out.
id       stable key; the run remembers which walls are done by it
zone     GET_NAME_OF_ZONE code, for reference only
gang     whose tag is on it -- decides the marker colour and who turns up
x, y, z  where Franklin stands to paint
heading  which way he faces, which should be square on to the wall
The mission picks four of these at random, so more entries means a run you can do twice
without it being the same afternoon. Add as many as you like.
